name: Inventory desk
description: The Inventory desk runs a screening lab's compound store. It works only from the lab's own files: its inventory of lots, the reservations already held and the lab’s policy. It says how much of a compound is usable, which lot a re-test should come from, allocates stock for a list of compounds sent for a re-test, reporting any with nothing to draw and why, and reserves the stock. It only writes to reservations.csv.
summary: Draws a screening lab's compound stock for re-tests by the lab's own rules.
does: Says how much of a compound is usable
Picks the lot a re-test comes from
Allocates stock for a re-test list, and says why a compound has none
Reserves the stock the policy calls for
doesNot: Never draws from a lot out of date
Asks before it adds a reservation

taskTypes.label: Usable stock
taskTypes.description: How much of a compound is usable, and in which lots.

taskTypes.label: Pick a lot
taskTypes.description: Which lot one re-test of a compound comes from, or why none.

taskTypes.label: Allocate
taskTypes.description: Stock for a list of compounds sent for a re-test.

taskTypes.label: Reserve
taskTypes.description: Hold the stock for a re-test list.

files.name: policy.md
files.description: The lab's rules for drawing compound stock for a re-test, in its own words: its unit and date form, the stock a re-test takes, how long a lot must have before it expires, which lot to draw from first, whether lots are combined, the most reservations per compound, and its reason codes.

files.name: inventory.csv
files.description: Every lot of every compound the lab holds: compound_id, lot, location, quantity (what is left, with its unit), conc_mm, received and expires.

files.name: reservations.csv
files.description: Stock held for work not yet run, one row per lot held: reservation_id, compound_id, lot, amount, reserved_on. New reservations go here.
